title: בּוּ — בּוּ וְהָאוֹת א (Bu and the letter Aleph)
notes: Bu's debut — the letter aleph. mode:kids. Nikkud captions ON (kidsNikkud), lineHeight ~1.5. Voice = FREE edge-tts he-IL-HilaNeural motherese (--rate -8% --pitch +4Hz); no ElevenLabs emotion tags (edge-tts has none) — warmth comes from rate/pitch + script. Call-and-response pauses are written into the beats (engineered [— 2.5s] gaps in the script are realized by voice window spacing, NOT a word). Images: 8 beats x fast tier via gen_image.py --ref character.jpg. Seamless loop: last frame visually settles to match frame 0. `text` = clean Hebrew (nikkud) for captions; `tts` = same line, nikkud kept (edge-tts reads nikkud fine; Hila is warm).

vo.note: engineered expectant pause — Bu hums softly while the child answers. edge-tts can't synthesize bare '...' (NoAudioReceived), so we use a soft warm hum word as the pause filler.
